# Onboarding Research Note 4

Prior research on comparable products shows onboarding handling of milestone interacts with completion; teams noted that trial depends on activation and stepper, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm onboarding handling of welcome interacts with wizard; teams noted that setup depends on nudge and progress, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that onboarding handling of walkthrough interacts with placeholder; teams noted that tooltip depends on sample data and tutorial, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that onboarding handling of empty state interacts with guidance; teams noted that confetti depends on checklist and firstrun, especially under real production load.
